parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem: An unstable nucleus $^{A}_{Z}X$ decays by emitting a $\beta^{-}$ particle.
parts.text: Determine quantitatively the changes, if any, in $A$ and $Z$ when $X$ decays.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
In addition to the $\beta^{-}$ particle, another lepton is emitted during the decay.

State the name of the other lepton that is emitted.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: A particle $P$ is composed of an up quark ($u$) and a down antiquark ($\bar{d}$).
parts.text:
Calculate the charge $q$ of particle $P$ in terms of $e$, where $e$ is the elementary charge.

Show your working.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
Particle $P$ belongs to **two** classes (groups) of particles.

State the names of these two classes.
